_comment: Ground truth for documents/trade_confirmation_004.pdf. Deliberate trap: 'Total Value: $192,500.00 (approx. EUR 178,325 at reference FX 0.9264)' puts a decoy EUR figure directly beside the USD notional, testing whether the model keeps notional_currency=USD instead of latching onto the parenthetical EUR amount or figure. 'Unit:' line also sits between the bare Quantity number and Price, same positional trap as doc 003/the original Day-2 bug. delivery_location and delivery_period are scored here (unlike doc 001/003) because 'Delivery Terms' and 'Delivery Point' both give the identical string, and 'Flow Period: August 15-31, 2026' unambiguously gives the delivery window.
